title: The Sunny Hill
offer: My old aunt Gerd moves to Solby, to her sister. She owns the sunny hill by your farm, and says: whoever rows me and my chests gets the hill! She has three chests.

steps.load_say: Aunt Gerd: My chests! Careful, the blue one has my grandmother's spoons.
steps.say: Aunt Gerd's chests? Bring her too!
My sister! And my chests! You are good girls. The sunny hill is yours: plant something beautiful on it.

fact: The land of a family passed from mother and father to the children; women could own land too.
